age.title: Your age
age.hint: This camp is for adults only.

under18.title: This camp is for ages 18 and over
body: It's completely natural to be curious about this or to want to change something. You're not alone.
This camp was made for adults. Getting support suited to your age is best.

help.title: An adult you trust
help.text: Talking to your mother, father, a relative or an older person you trust can be a first step.

help.title: School counsellor
help.text: The counsellor or school psychologist at your school will listen to you in confidence.

help.title: Yeşilay Helpline 115 (Türkiye)
help.text: YEDAM also gives free counselling to children and teenagers in Türkiye. You can call and talk.

under18.emergency: In an emergency, call 112 (or your local emergency number).

items.text: This isn't a diagnostic tool. It doesn't put a label on you; it only helps you see where you are.
Sexuality and masturbation are part of human nature. The aim here is to bring the behaviour to where you want it to be.
Shame makes change harder. There's no judgement here; every step is a chance to learn.
Everything stays on this phone, behind a lock and encrypted. No server, no account.

lock.title: Camp lock
lock.body: Your phone's lock (face, fingerprint or passcode) is asked every time you enter the camp; if your phone has no lock, you set your own PIN. The camp locks again when the app goes to the background.

reasons.title: What brings you here?
reasons.hint: You can choose more than one.

options.label: How often I masturbate bothers me
I feel bad about myself (shame / guilt)
It has become my way of coping with anxiety or stress

reasons.otherPlaceholder: Write it in your own words (optional)

bps.title: Short self-check (last 6 months)
bps.hint: Think about the last 6 months and pick the closest answer for each item. There are no right or wrong answers.
items: I watched for longer than I had planned.
I wanted to cut down or stop but found it hard.
It got in the way of my work, studies, sleep or relationships.
When I felt stressed, bored or lonely, it was the first thing on my mind.
Afterwards I felt bad, guilty or uneasy.
bps.resultHigh: Your answers may show that your use is causing you difficulty. Talking to a professional could help.
bps.resultLow: Your answers don't point to a high level of difficulty. Still, if something bothers you, this camp can help.
bps.nonJudge: This isn't a diagnosis. It only shows where you are today; on days 42 and 90 you can look again and see your own progress.

freq.title: On how many days in the last 2 weeks?
freq.hint: A rough number is enough. This is only so you can see your own starting point.
freq.porn: Number of days you watched pornography

triggers.title: In which situations does it happen most?
triggers.hint: You can choose more than one. These will be the topic of your first plans.

options.label: At night in bed with my phone
When I wake up in the morning

emotions.title: What do you feel before and after?
emotions.hint: Noticing the feeling afterwards helps you see what the behaviour really gives you.

values.title: What kind of person do you want to be in this?
values.hint: Choose the values that matter to you and, if you like, write your own sentence. We'll remind you of them in hard moments.
values.textPlaceholder: Example: I want to give my time and attention to the things I care about.

moral.title: Fit with your values
moral.statement: This behaviour conflicts with my values.
moral.note: This answer is only used to order the content for you, not to judge you.

mood.title: Your mood over the last 2 weeks
mood.hint: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?
phq: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
gad: Feeling nervous, anxious or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying
mood.resultHigh: The last few days may have been hard. Talking to a professional could help; this camp doesn't replace that, but it can be alongside you.
mood.resultLow: Thank you. Your mood matters in this process; we'll ask about it in the daily checks too.

attempts.title: Have you tried before? What happened?
attempts.hint: You can choose more than one. Previous attempts show us what to watch out for this time.

options.label: I gave up completely after a slip
I set up a filter but got around it

attempts.note: Having tried before is really valuable: you know what didn't work.

goal.title: Choose your goal
goal.hint: You choose separately for each behaviour. No goal is more correct than another; you can change it any time.

options.label: Take a break for a set time

goal.note: Masturbation itself isn't considered medically harmful. Your goal should be set by what you want for your values and quality of life.
goal.undecidedNote: Not having decided is also a start. In the first week you can get clear on what you want by monitoring yourself.

risky.title: Your riskiest hours
risky.hint: You can choose more than one time range. Notifications and your boundaries plan are set around these hours.

plans.title: Your first 3 plans
plans.hint: Choose an "If… then…" plan for the situations you struggle with most. Deciding in advance is much easier than deciding in the moment.
plans.empty: You didn't choose a situation. You can add your plans later from the camp panel.

expert.title: Talking to a professional could help
expert.body: You can get an appointment at a psychiatry clinic or with a clinical psychologist. In Türkiye, the Yeşilay Helpline 115 also offers free counselling; you can ask on the line about the scope of help.
expert.emergency: In an emergency, call 112 (or your local emergency number).

summary.title: Your plan is ready
boundaries: Charge your phone outside the bedroom.
Switch your screen to greyscale at night.
Separate your work and sleep areas.
Plan another activity for your risky hours.
summary.boundariesNote: No filter is unbeatable. A filter is a brake; the real strength is your skills and your plan.
summary.programIntro: A 6-week core programme, then consolidation up to day 90.

phases.name: Awareness
phases.focus: Self-monitoring, triggers, values, shaping your environment

phases.name: Boundaries
phases.focus: Environment and digital boundaries, risky-hour plans

phases.name: Skills
phases.focus: Urge surfing, defusing from thoughts, emotion regulation

phases.name: Rebuild
phases.focus: Healthy routines, connection, meaning, sleep, movement

porn.reduce: Pornography: at most {n} days a week

mast.reduce: Masturbation: at most {n} days a week

summary.bpsAgain: We'll redo the short screening on days 42 and 90; only so you can see your own progress.
